complete_database_migration.rationale: Governed: can apply tested migration changes to the main branch and remove temporary resources.

complete_query_tuning.rationale: Governed: can merge query-tuning schema changes into the main branch or discard the tuning branch.

create_branch.rationale: Governed: creates a database branch and associated compute/storage resources.

create_project.rationale: Governed: creates a hosted Neon project with billable database resources.

explain_sql_statement.rationale: Governed: EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the supplied statement and can expose production query data.

get_connection_string.rationale: Governed: resolves a reusable database credential; deployments must prevent the resolved secret from reaching the proposer.

list_slow_queries.rationale: Governed: retrieves production query text and performance telemetry that can contain sensitive values.

prepare_database_migration.rationale: Governed: creates a temporary branch and executes generated DDL for later promotion.

prepare_query_tuning.rationale: Governed: creates a temporary branch and may apply generated indexes or schema changes.

provision_neon_auth.rationale: Governed: provisions authentication infrastructure and a third-party Stack Auth integration.

reset_from_parent.rationale: Governed: resets a branch to its parent and can discard all branch-local data and schema changes.

run_sql.rationale: Governed: executes arbitrary SQL, including writes, DDL, destructive statements, and sensitive reads.

run_sql_transaction.rationale: Governed: executes an arbitrary multi-statement SQL transaction with write and destructive capability.
